screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.ae_l: Put the Cosmic Artisan in the top-right linking slot of a Wireless Access Point. Retrieve it and enable AE Storage Priority. Insertion works at any distance while the access point is loaded and online. Enable Link Mode to sneak-right-click and link directly.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.auto: After closing settings, repeat up to four right clicks per tick while holding the tool. Leaving the world stops it.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.prot: Sneak and right-click a mob to toggle its protection. Area damage and kill aura pause while editing.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.forc: Right-click to advance random ticks. This can also cause decay, melting, or spread.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.silk: Apply Silk Touch when calculating mining drops. Eligible blocks drop themselves.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.fort: Apply Fortune III when calculating mining drops. Eligible blocks may drop more or have a higher chance to drop items.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.forc: Directly kill eligible living targets when attacking. PvP rules and Player Protection still apply.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.behe: Drop an extra head when killing eligible mobs such as skeletons, zombies, and creepers.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.capt: Killing a mob that has a spawn egg drops that egg with selected details such as its name and variant.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.area: Attacks also damage eligible mobs near the target. Players, allies, tamed animals, and protected mobs are skipped.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.kill: While held in the main hand, attack eligible nearby mobs once per second. The protection list applies.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.play: Carrying the Cosmic Artisan with this option enabled grants damage immunity when allowed by world settings.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.magn: Collect experience directly, move mob drops to your feet, and try to pick up loose items near the defeated mob.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.hoe_: When a dirt block can be tilled or turned into a path, prefer the tool action shown on the button.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.crop: Right-click to harvest mature crops and replant them in place.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.shea: Right-click an eligible mob to perform the vanilla shears action.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.flin: Right-click to perform the vanilla ignition action or ignite an unlit creeper.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.ripe: Right-click an eligible block to apply bone meal growth or a baby mob to make it an adult.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.wren: Lets compatible mods recognize the Cosmic Artisan as a wrench for their interactions.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.chai: Breaking a block also mines neighboring connected blocks of the same type, up to 64 blocks per break.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.auto: Convert smeltable mining drops directly into their furnace outputs.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.time: Controls all acceleration. Sneak-right-click a target or use Shift + scroll to change speed; additional options are in acceleration settings.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.enti: Allow acceleration of non-player entities while the time acceleration master switch is on.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.adva: While held in the main hand, maintain invisibility with its particles and icon hidden.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.forc: Left-click a nearby block to try to break it immediately. Region protection and interaction permissions still apply.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.cons: Supply blocks in the off hand and right-click to build along the selected face. Angel Core and Destruction Core change the action.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.ange: With Construction Wand enabled, extend a straight line from the selected face. Right-click in air to bridge forward up to 16 blocks.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.dest: Enable Construction Wand, then right-click to break up to 81 connected matching blocks along the selected face.
screen.sh_common_lib.cosmic_artisan.ae_s: Send mining and mob drops to the linked online AE network first. Items that cannot be inserted drop as usual.
